newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-PAO DE ACUCAR UPGRADED.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-PAO DE ACUCAR UPGRADED.

text.p: HSBC James Capel said it had upgraded Brazilian supermarket chain Grupo Pao de Acucar to buy from long-term buy.
-- also said it had raised its 1997 earnings estimates to $140.3 million from $133 million.
-- "Our new earnings estimate assumes that Pao de Acucar's gross margins for the full 1997 year will reach 26 percent versus the 25.2 percent recorded in 1996," it said in a report.
-- Preferred shares of Pao de Acucar, formally known as Companhia Brasileira de Distribuicao, were 4.05 percent higher at 25.70 reais earlier on the Sao Paulo bolsa.
-- Its ADR was up 5/8 at 23-5/8 on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE).
